file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE lists 176 .raw files: 56 TMT10_B, 56 TMT10_Y, 64 label-free. This SDRF references exactly the 112 TMT10_* files, each with exactly 10 rows carrying 10 distinct labels. Sibling annotations/PXD003710-lf.sdrf.tsv references the other 64 files once each with no TMT10_* files; overlap = 0 and union equals the PRIDE RAW set exactly, so every deposited RAW file is claimed exactly once. Fraction identifiers 1-56 per plex map positionally (x1-3 -> 1, xN -> N-2, x58-60 -> 56) with no exceptions, matching the 60-fraction / pooled 1-3 and 58-60 design.

design_consistency.evidence: 19 source names: 18 pools + 1 reference; characteristics constant per source. Each pool appears in exactly one plex; reference appears in both with comment[technical replicate] 1 (Y) / 2 (B), all other channels technical replicate 1. Biological replicate A/B/C = 1/2/3; pooled sample 'not pooled' only for KO 0 C and WT 0 C (1 mouse each per Table 1), 'pooled' for the 2-3 mouse pools (membership not deposited, so SN= correctly not used). Disease normal for 0 day (euthanized before immunization) and EAE for 10/20 day. Factor values genotype and sampling time match characteristics; reference is 'not applicable'. Every genotype x time condition has pools in both plexes (KO: A,B in Y and C in B; WT: A in Y and B,C in B), so plex is not confounded with condition, though it is partially confounded with genotype (Y holds 6 KO + 3 WT pools, B holds 3 KO + 6 WT), as designed by the authors.

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than evidence supports: organism part is the less specific 'cerebral hemisphere' (source says frontal part of right hemisphere); sex and developmental stage 'not available' (source only says age- and sex-matched); alkylation reagent column omitted because not stated; pooled-sample membership not invented. No search parameter file exists, and modifications/tolerances match the protocol verbatim with TMT/carbamidomethyl confirmed by PRIDE identified PTMs. A PRIDE-hosted PXD003710_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv (Last-Modified 2026-10-27) is identical to this artifact except dissociation method NT=HCD;AC=PRIDE:0000590; it is treated as the same lineage, not independent evidence, and the artifact uses the spec-required MS:1000422.
